Margins & costs: Net profit of INR42 crores, which is 26% growth over quarter 1 FY26, and net profit margin stood at 22%.
And our land cost to GDV is very healthy, and there is no debt on the project.
Capex & expansion: In spite continuing to invest in business development, our net debt to equity remains negligible at 0.07x and our ratings, AA long-term rating from India Ratings, Fitch Group, remains among the strongest in Indian real estate.

We generated a net cash flow surplus of INR193 crores during the quarter, a growth of 79% over quarter 1 FY26 after deploying INR170 crores towards business development and land-related capital expenditure.
